explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at D2 it fires only when the agent chose a2 and got the rare transition to S1, mostly around trials 63 to 78 of the episode, where it is usually 8 to 10 (it can drop to 0 to 7 when the trial before was also a rare a2 to S1). The same rare a2 to S1 event earlier than about trial 60 or later than about trial 80 stays at 0, and so does every common transition and every a1 trial.
